fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects Microsoft Excel loading an Add-In (.xll) file from an uncommon location
fields.name: Microsoft Excel Add-In Loaded From Uncommon Location
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "\\excel.exe" and (module.path contains "\\Desktop\\" or module.path contains "\\Downloads\\" or module.path contains "\\Perflogs\\" or module.path contains "\\Temp\\" or module.path contains "\\Users\\Public\\" or module.path contains "\\Windows\\Tasks\\") and module.path contains ".xll"))
